output.reason: [ev-1252a2a51c0c] and [ev-4bada370a9ca]/[ev-d30ab61d3afc] say only that the change affects "the networking.istio.io/exportTo annotation". The cited text never says which resource kinds carry it, so the proposal's four Istio CRDs (VirtualService, DestinationRule, ServiceEntry, Gateway) are not supported by the evidence. The proposed exposure is also too broad. The issue says that only annotation values with extra whitespace between namespaces (e.g. "ns1, ns2") failed to export to ns2 and will now behave differently. So the condition should match that whitespace pattern, not just check that the annotation is set. A correction would need the resource kind(s) that carry the annotation, for example from the linked PR #53367's description or changed files, which are not in the excerpts.
